name: Import Circuit Image into KiCad
description: Turn a photo, screenshot, scan, or hand-drawn sketch of a circuit into an editable KiCad schematic.
description_full: Pick a circuit image (PNG, JPG, or WebP) and this plugin converts it into an editable .kicad_sch schematic using S2S (sketch-to-schematic). The generated schematic opens in KiCad, where you can keep editing; you can also continue online at s2s.diy to run electrical checks and simulate the circuit. The plugin authenticates with a personal API token generated in the S2S web app. It runs from the PCB Editor (Tools -> External Plugins).
